description: Angular component for a liquid level widget in a dashboard, handling SVG rendering, tooltips, data fetching, and color updates.

classes.name: LiquidLevelWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a liquid level indicator widget with SVG rendering, tooltip, and data handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the widget, fetches data, and sets up styles and SVG.

methods.name: declareStyles
methods.description: Initializes color and date format processors based on settings.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches SVG and tank parameters based on data sources.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Sets border radius style and triggers change detection.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates SVG and value display based on current data.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup logic.

methods.name: createSVG
methods.description: Configures SVG element styles.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates SVG fill level and tooltip based on data.

methods.name: createTooltip
methods.description: Dynamically loads tooltipster library and initializes tooltip with content.

methods.name: createValueElement
methods.description: Sets up overlay elements for value display.

methods.name: getShape
methods.description: Retrieves shape attribute for tank SVG based on entity attribute.

methods.name: getTankersParams
methods.description: Fetches volume and units attributes for tankers, with fallback to static settings.

methods.name: createdErrorMsg
methods.description: Logs attribute errors and updates error messages.

methods.name: updateSvg
methods.description: Calculates position and updates SVG fill level and color.

methods.name: calculatePosition
methods.description: Calculates SVG Y position based on percentage and limits.

methods.name: updateTooltip
methods.description: Updates tooltip content with current data.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Animates SVG fill and surface positions to reflect level.

methods.name: updateShapeColor
methods.description: Updates SVG shape stroke and fill colors based on level.

methods.name: updateValueElement
methods.description: Updates displayed value and volume text based on data and layout.

methods.name: getTooltipContent
methods.description: Generates HTML content for tooltip with level and date info.

methods.name: createTooltipContent
methods.description: Creates HTML snippet for tooltip label and value.

methods.name: convertInputData
methods.description: Converts raw data to percentage based on source units.

methods.name: convertOutputData
methods.description: Converts percentage to volume units.

methods.name: convertTooltipData
methods.description: Converts data value to tooltip units.

methods.name: cardClick
methods.description: Handles card click actions.
